Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.core

Class AffinityManager

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.core.AffinityManager
public final class AffinityManager extends Object
Core affinity manager that orchestrates CPU affinity, NUMA, topology, and performance operations. Thread-safe, production-ready implementation with proper error handling and caching.
